root_cause.text: The teql qdisc was not restricted to root-only usage, causing qlen accounting to break when used as a child qdisc (since teql only updates qlen at dequeue and its peek always returns NULL), which led to incorrect class deactivation and a use-after-free in the parent QFQ scheduler.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (sch->parent != TC_H_ROOT)` to reject teql as a non-root qdisc; the CVE description details the UAF scenario triggered by using teql as a child under QFQ due to qlen not being incremented on enqueue.

bic_trace_step.reason: The teql qdisc's init function (teql_qdisc_init) does not enforce that it can only be used as a root qdisc. It directly attaches itself to the master device's slave list without any check on the parent. This allows it to be used as a child qdisc, which together with the simplified qlen accounting in teql_dequeue (sch->q.qlen = dat->q.qlen + dat->m->dev->qdisc->q.qlen) and the absence of a peek operation, leads to the described vulnerability (broken qlen accounting and potential use-after-free).
